WORKSPACE_TOOL_ROUTING_INSTRUCTION_TEXT is 1,961 source bytes at both commits, the base agent instruction text file is unchanged, apps/cli/product-manifest.json is unchanged, and the capability-builtin-tools / capability-tool-catalog packages are unchanged, so the tool list and its descriptions are the same set the previous run used. The changes that do exist are inside compact.ts (report-generation wiring), upgrade-tui.ts (upgrade dialog), capability-process-tools (presentation isolation) and capability-network-tools (search provider tests), none of which is on a headless tool-calling path the benchmark exercises.

candidateDeltaAudit.buildAndDeliveryChanges: MATERIAL FOR PACKAGING, NOT FOR BEHAVIOUR. This commit introduces a native workspace read helper: build-cli-sea.mjs writes <target>/workspace-read-helper, stage-cli-sea-packages.mjs verifies its bytes against the build report and ships it as bin/workspace-read-helper with a bin-map entry best-agent-workspace-read-helper-<target>, and apps/cli/package.json adds dist/workspace-read-helper to files plus ajv 8.18.0 to the bundled runtime dependencies. The delivery gate is presence-based on the tarball (every declared bin member must exist and be executable, runtime/bin/node must exist, each declared runtime dependency must be installed at its exact version), so an extra staged binary is admitted by construction; the candidate directory still holds exactly the three frozen files, so packaging.files is unaffected. The SEA is also trimmed (unused MathJax browser prebuilds are omitted), which changes tarball size and bytes but nothing the model sees.

A verdict difference must still be read as those deltas plus run-to-run variance, and the provider variance measured in the previous run's recheck (one flip, three repeats) is a live confounder for any single-cell comparison.

mitigation.providerVariance: No budget, timeout or effort is extended for any cell, and no re-measurement is predeclared by this manifest. The previous run's recheck showed that three of four provider-stalled cells reproduce the stall inside their own budget (largest-eigenval lost 771 s of 900 s), so a repeat here would be an expected reading of the provider conditions, not a new defect.
mitigation.noCleanClaim: No contamination gate and public egress, so this run claims no cell was clean. Any cell whose record is to be used as a capability reading still needs its own contamination receipt.

constraints: One predeclared attempt per cell over the exact frozen corpus; no second attempt in this manifest.
No verdict, frozen record, repair or artifact of 40257143514, 40268344770, 40272786791, 39883822819 or any earlier run is replaced, repaired or reinterpreted by this run.
Nothing here is read as a model-capability result: with public egress and no contamination gate, a model failure cannot be separated from an answer source a cell may have reached.
Every error cell keeps its mechanical cause in the record; an error is never counted as a model failure.
No budget, timeout or effort is extended to make any cell scoreable.
This run's pass@1 comes only from its own frozen aggregate report, and only if every predeclared cell carries a verdict.

knownRisks.firstBuildOfThisCommit: No six-platform release exists for ce69441c yet, and the commit adds a native read helper to the delivered package. If that packaging path fails on linux-x64-gnu, fh-candidate fails closed before any model call and the run produces no verdicts; that is a pre-model build failure, not a benchmark result.
knownRisks.providerVariance: The previous recheck measured one flip (scc) and three repeats (extract-elf, largest-eigenval, code-from-image) under the same provider conditions. A recurrence here is expected and is not evidence about the candidate.
knownRisks.noContaminationGate: Public egress and no gate: a cell that reaches its upstream solution is not detected here.
knownRisks.emptyPatchCaptureGap: The datacurve collect hook diffs base..HEAD, so a cell that edits without committing still grades the pristine tree. Not changed here.
knownRisks.rerun: One attempt per cell. A cell that fails keeps its canonical verdict; no retry is admitted by this manifest.
knownRisks.noReproducibleBinary: The SEA build is not byte-reproducible, so this run's binarySha256 is its own; the receipt and the per-run candidateId are the only identity that binds the attempts to the pinned commit.
knownRisks.smokeGate: No full run is dispatched until a single-task smoke has proven the new candidate builds, delivery-verifies (including the new read helper), materializes glm-5.3 at high and reaches the model phase with frozen evidence.
